name: rlarch
description: René Larch's Claude Code skills — .NET API-surface inspection, ReSharper-style .NET source navigation, and subagent orchestration for large multi-phase work.

plugins.name: rlarch
plugins.description: All three skills in one plugin: dotnet-reflect (inspect .NET NuGet/assembly API surfaces — signatures, XML docs, decompiled bodies, version diffs, reverse find-usages, straight from the DLL on disk), dotnet-source (ReSharper-style source navigation for the solution you're editing — search, outline with private members, god-class metrics, semantic find-usages / impls / calls / unused via Roslyn, works on code that doesn't compile), and orchestrate (execute a large plan or spec by delegating every task to subagents, verifying each result, and re-planning when reality diverges).
